review_candidates.title: AI 集群 / GPU 基础设施工程师
review_candidates.company: 福州呈元网络技术有限公司
review_candidates.description: 该职位来源于猎聘 岗位定位 负责公司AI研发所使用的GPU服务器、训练/推理集群及相关基础设施。 核心目标是：让AI研发团队能够稳定、高效、公平地使用公司算力资源，同时保证GPU集群稳定、安全、可观测、可维护。 主要职责 1.GPU集群管理 o 负责GPU服务器及AI计算集群的部署、配置、维护和生命周期管理。 o 管理GPU、CPU、内存、存储及网络等计算资源。 o 保证训练和推理环境的稳定运行。 2.算力调度与资源分配 o 根据团队及项目需求制定合理的GPU资源分配策略。 o 建设和维护任务排队、资源配额、优先级及抢占机制。 o 提升GPU利用率，减少资源闲置及资源争抢。 3.集群调度系统 o 维护或建设基于 Kubernetes、Slurm 或其他调度系统的AI计算环境。 o 支持单机多卡、多机多卡及分布式训练场景。 o 管理不同项目、团队及用户的资源隔离。 4.AI研发环境建设 o 建设标准化开发、训练及推理环境。 o 管理CUDA、Driver、PyTorch、Docker、Container Runtime等基础环境。 o 降低算法工程师配置环境及使用集群的成本。 5.存储和数据基础设施 o 管理AI研发相关高速存储、共享存储及数据访问权限。 o 优化模型、训练数据及Checkpoint读写性能。 o 建立数据备份、容量监控及生命周期管理机制。 6.监控与稳定性 o 建设GPU、CPU、内存、磁盘、网络等监控体系。 o 建立集群告警、故障定位及恢复机制。 o 对GPU利用率、显存利用率、任务排队时间等关键指标进行持续优化。 7.成本与容量管理 o 定期分析GPU利用率和团队算力需求。 o 为服务器扩容、GPU采购及云上算力使用提供数据依据。 o 在性能、稳定性和成本之间进行合理权衡。 8.权限与安全 o 管理服务器账号、SSH Key、访问权限及项目隔离。 o 建立最小权限、操作审计及离职账号回收机制。 o 配合公司安全要求完成基础设施安全管理。 我们希望你具备 1、计算机、软件工程、网络工程或相关专业背景。 2、扎实的Linux系统管理能力。 3、熟悉NVIDIA GPU、CUDA、Driver及常见AI训练环境。 4、管理过8卡、16卡、32卡或更大规模GPU集群。 5、有H100 / H200 / A100 / A800 / H800或类似NVIDIA GPU卡的服务器经验。 6、熟悉Docker / Container Runtime。 7、熟悉 Kubernetes 或 Slurm 中至少一种集群调度体系。 8、熟悉GPU任务调度、资源Quota和多用户集群管理。 9、熟悉Linux网络、存储、权限管理及常见故障排查。 10、能使用Python / Shell完成运维自动化。 加分项 1、有InfiniBand、RoCE、高速网络或RDMA经验。 2、熟悉NCCL及分布式训练问题排查。 3、熟悉Prometheus、Grafana、DCGM等监控体系。 4、熟悉Ceph、NFS、Lustre、对象存储等存储方案。 5、有MLOps / Model Serving / vLLM / Triton等推理基础设施经验。 6、有AI研发团队内部平台建设经验。 我们希望你既有较强的Infra能力，也能够理解AI研发工作负载的特殊性，成为整个AI团队的算力基础设施Owner。

review_candidates.title: Application & System Support
review_candidates.description: 1. Job Purpose To provide technical and functional support for enterprise applications, ensuring system stability, performance, and business continuity. The role requires strong SQL and programming capabilities to troubleshoot application issues, analyze data, develop system enhancements, and drive continuous improvement through automation and AI-enabled solutions. 2. Key Responsibilities A. Application Support & Maintenance Provide Level 2 application support for enterprise and business applications. Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve application incidents, system errors, integration failures, and performance issues. Monitor application health, interfaces, scheduled jobs, and system availability. Perform root cause analysis (RCA) and implement preventive measures to minimize recurring incidents. Coordinate with business users, infrastructure teams, and external vendors to resolve technical issues. Maintain application documentation, technical specifications, and standard operating procedures (SOPs). B. SQL & Database Management Develop and execute SQL queries for data extraction, validation, reconciliation, and troubleshooting. Analyze database tables, relationships, stored procedures, and application data flows. Investigate data inconsistencies, transaction failures, and application performance issues. Support database optimization, reporting requirements, and data integrity improvements. Work with databases such as Microsoft SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL, or Oracle. C. Programming & System Enhancement Develop, maintain, and troubleshoot application scripts, programs, and system interfaces. Support minor application enhancements, bug fixes, and change requests. Develop API integrations, automation scripts, and utilities to improve system functionality. Participate in system testing, user acceptance testing (UAT), deployment, and post-implementation support. Apply secure coding practices, version control, and change management procedures. D. AI & Automation Initiatives Proactively identify repetitive manual tasks and opportunities for process automation. Develop automation solutions using scripting, RPA, workflow tools, or AI technologies. Explore practical applications of AI in incident analysis, application monitoring, reporting, and technical support. Leverage AI-assisted development tools to improve coding efficiency, troubleshooting, and documentation. Evaluate and propose innovative solutions to improve operational efficiency, reduce manual effort, and enhance user experience. Ensure automation and AI solutions comply with organizational security, data protection, and governance requirements. E. System Integration & Project Support Support integration between enterprise applications, databases, APIs, and external systems. Participate in application upgrades, system migrations, and digital transformation projects. Assist with technical assessments, impact analysis, and implementation activities. Work closely with business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into technical solutions. 3. Qualifications & Technical Requirements Education Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related discipline. Experience Executive: 2–4 years of relevant experience in application support, software development, or database management. Senior Executive: 4–6 years of relevant experience in enterprise application support and technical troubleshooting. Mandatory Technical Skills Strong SQL knowledge, including joins, stored procedures, query optimization, and data troubleshooting. Working knowledge of at least one programming language, such as Python, Java, C#, JavaScript, or .NET. Experience troubleshooting application errors, database issues, and system integrations. Understanding of REST APIs, JSON, web services, and application interfaces. Familiarity with application deployment, incident management, and change management processes. Added Advantages Experience with AI-assisted development tools, such as GitHub Copilot or ChatGPT. Knowledge of automation tools such as Power Automate, UiPath, or Python scripting. Exposure to Microsoft Azure, AWS, or cloud-hosted enterprise applications. Experience with ERP, Dealer Management Systems (DMS), SAP, or other enterprise applications. Familiarity with Power BI, data analytics, and reporting automation. Knowledge of Git, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps practices. 4. Key Competencies Analytical Thinking: Strong ability to investigate complex application and data-related issues. Problem Solving: Ability to identify root causes and implement sustainable solutions. Automation Mindset: Proactively seeks opportunities to eliminate repetitive tasks and improve efficiency. AI & Innovation: Willingness to explore and adopt emerging technologies to enhance application support. Technical Learning Agility: Ability to quickly learn new programming languages, tools, and platforms. Communication: Able to explain technical issues clearly to business users and stakeholders. Ownership & Accountability: Takes responsibility for incident resolution, system reliability, and continuous improvement. Teamwork: Collaborates effectively with internal teams, business users, and vendors. 5. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) KPI Area Performance Expectations -Application Availability : Maintain system stability and minimize unplanned disruptions -Incident Resolution : Resolve incidents within agreed SLA -Root Cause Analysis : Reduce recurring incidents through permanent fixes -SQL & Technical Support : Ensure accuracy and timely resolution of data-related issues -Automation & Improvement : Deliver measurable improvements through automation -AI Adoption : Identify and implement practical AI-assisted support use cases -System Enhancement : Deliver assigned changes within agreed timelines and quality standards -Documentation : Maintain accurate technical documentation and SOPs 6. Expected Outcome The successful candidate should be capable of independently troubleshooting application and database issues, developing technical solutions, and actively driving automation and AI adoption to improve application support efficiency, reliability, and overall business productivity.
